verdict.rationale: Ramp's llms.txt index links a canonical OpenAPI schema at /openapi/developer-api.json, and a hands-on probe confirmed it returns HTTP 200 as a parseable OpenAPI document titled "Ramp Developer API" (v1) with 174 paths. Ramp also publishes a plain-text generated API reference and an unauthenticated Developer MCP that serves OpenAPI schemas. First-party docs plus independent live verification cover the story fully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: GET https://docs.ramp.com/openapi/developer-api.json returns HTTP 200 — a parseable OpenAPI document titled "Ramp Developer API" (v1) with 174 documented paths
